headline: Not an official partner
text: boAt product sold by Random Traders on Amazon.in. boAt's listed Amazon.in sellers: Appario Retail, Techretailer, Techvast Pvt. Ltd. and 8 more.

source.text: boAt's own warranty page: 'Authorised Sales Channels' and 'Authorised Sellers'

reasons: Random Traders is not among the 11 sellers boAt names for Amazon.in
The list may name a seller by its company name, and a seller not on it can still be genuine
label: From the brand's own published page, not a regulator's finding. A seller that is not named can still be genuine: lists change, and a seller may trade under another name.
